record.title: Recording setup
record.systemAudioHint: Sound played by the computer (videos, notifications…)
record.qualityHint: Always records at the screen's native resolution so zooms stay sharp; pick the output resolution when exporting.
record.keystrokesHint: Used to show keyboard shortcuts in the video. Off by default for privacy.
record.keystrokesAllBody: Every character you type while recording — including passwords — will be saved in the recording. Only turn this on if you are sure you won't type anything sensitive.
record.areaUnits: Real screen pixels ({{w}} × {{h}}). Press Enter or click outside to apply.
record.previewDenied: Windows is blocking apps from using the {{kind}}.
record.previewFailed: Can't preview this device (another app may be using it).
record.frame: Add background & frame (background, padding, corners, shadow)
record.frameHint: Untick to keep the full recorded frame. You can turn it on or off later in the editor.

region.hint: Drag to select · Enter to confirm · Esc to cancel

recorded.title: Recording saved
recorded.tooShortBody: This recording is only {{secs}} s long. Keep it or discard it?

recovery.title: Recover unfinished recordings?
recovery.body: Mochi Studio closed unexpectedly while recording. The recorded part can be recovered:

error.notIdle: Settings can't be changed while recording.
error.lowDisk: Only {{free}} free on the drive; at least {{required}} is needed to start recording.
error.targetNotFound: The recording target is gone — the screen/window may have been closed or minimized.
error.cameraNotFound: The selected webcam was not found.
error.permissionDenied: Windows is blocking apps from using the {{kind}}. Open Settings › Privacy to allow it.

warning.deviceLost: {{kind}} disconnected — the other sources are still recording.
warning.diskLow: The drive is almost full ({{free}} left).
warning.stoppedDiskFull: Stopped because the drive is almost full. What was recorded is kept.
warning.windowClosed: The recorded window was closed — recording paused.
warning.windowMinimized: The recorded window was minimized — recording paused. Restore it, then press Resume.
warning.displayChanged: The screen resolution changed — continued in a new segment.
warning.displayLost: The recorded screen was disconnected — recording paused.
warning.frameDrops: Dropping {{rate}}% of frames. Try 30 fps or Standard quality.
warning.encoderFallback: The hardware encoder can't be used for this recording — encoding in software ({{backend}}), which uses more CPU.
warning.pipelineFailed: Recording hit an error — stopped and saved what was recorded.
warning.areaOutOfBounds: The display changed resolution / scaling and the recording area is no longer inside it — paused. Stop and pick the area again.

editor.noMedia: Drop files or click Import media to add videos, audio and images.
editor.noSelection: Select a clip on the timeline to see its properties.
editor.removeInUseBody: This media is used by {{n}} clip(s) on the timeline. Removing it also removes those clips.
editor.duplicatesBody: These files have the same content as existing media:
editor.corruptBody: The project file can't be read. Open the latest backup?
editor.lockedBody: This project is open in another window or app.
editor.newerBody: This project was made by a newer Mochi Studio (schema {{found}} > {{supported}}). Please update the app.
editor.cameraHiddenRange: Webcam hidden from {{a}} to {{b}} (in the recording)
editor.useProxiesHint: Preview with a light 720p copy of videos / recordings larger than 1080p (export always uses the originals)
editor.removeTrackLocked: Track is locked — unlock it to delete
editor.removeTrackBody: This track has {{count}} clip(s). Deleting the track also deletes them (you can undo with Ctrl+Z).
editor.saveFrame: Save the current frame as a PNG image

timelineError.overlap: The clip would overlap another clip on the same track.
timelineError.wrongTrackKind: This media can't go on that track.
timelineError.effectNotSupported: This effect only works on recording clips.

projectError.newerSchema: The project needs a newer app version.
projectError.writeOutsideProject: Refused to write outside the project.

polish.detachAudio: Detach audio to its own track
polish.recoveredBody: Mochi Studio closed unexpectedly while this project was open. The latest autosave was opened — up to ~60 seconds of recent edits may be missing.
polish.pickPoint: Click the image to pick the zoom point
polish.frameOffHint: Off: the video keeps the full recorded frame.
polish.applyAll: Apply background, cursor and webcam to {{n}} other recording(s)
polish.applyAllHint: Copy this clip's background & frame, cursor and webcam settings to every other recording in the project (each recording keeps its own zooms).

export.title: Export video
export.rangeTitle: Export range (I / O, X to clear)
export.warnGif: Estimated GIF size is about {{size}} (over 50 MB). Try a lower fps, a smaller size or a shorter range.
export.warnName: The file name had invalid characters; it will be saved as: {{to}}
export.warnBlack: Missing media will be left blank: {{names}}
export.allowBlack: Export anyway, leaving missing media blank
export.queued: Waiting (another export of this project is running)
export.fallback: Hardware encoder failed; switched to {{to}} and restarted

err.missingMedia: The project has missing media: {{names}}. Relink it, or allow leaving those parts blank.
err.unsupportedEncoder: This PC can't encode this codec: {{reason}}
err.notWritable: Can't write to {{dir}}. Please choose another folder.
err.diskFull: Not enough disk space: about {{needed}} needed, {{free}} free.
err.emptyProject: The project has no clips yet.
err.cancelled: Cancelled, no partial file left behind.
err.crashed: The export process stopped unexpectedly. Log: {{log}}

export.subtitles: Also save a .srt subtitle file next to the video

gpu.title: GPU below minimum requirements
gpu.software: A software GPU is in use ({{name}}). Recording still works, but preview and export will be very slow.
gpu.none: No DirectX 12 GPU found ({{detail}}). Recording still works, but preview and export may be slow or unavailable.
gpu.requirement: Requirement: a DirectX 12 graphics card with an up-to-date driver. Please update your GPU driver.
gpu.oldDriver: The {{name}} driver is too old ({{driver}}). Update it from the vendor (NVIDIA / AMD / Intel) for stable preview and export.

cache.title: Cache
cache.note: Only proxies, thumbnails and waveforms are removed; recordings and original media are never deleted. They are rebuilt when needed.
cache.trimmed: Cache over its limit: removed the {{files}} oldest files ({{size}}).

saveFailed.title: Couldn't save the project
saveFailed.body: Your recent changes are not saved. You can try saving again (for example after freeing disk space or closing the program that locks the file), or stay and keep working.

hotkeys.title: Shortcuts
hotkeys.press: Press a key combination… (Esc to cancel)
hotkeys.hint: Click a box, then press the new combination. Letter / number keys need Ctrl, Alt or Shift.

recover.title: Mochi was closed unexpectedly
recover.body: Mochi didn't close normally last time. The project is open from the latest autosave. Keep it, or open an earlier saved version? (The current autosave stays in the backup list.)
recover.homeTitle: These projects weren't closed normally last time — reopen to recover:

highlight.title: Cursor highlight
highlight.recordHint: Not shown on screen while recording; appears in the preview and export, and can be changed / turned off later in the editor.
highlight.noCursorData: This recording has no cursor data.

preset.name: Preset name
preset.exists: A preset named "{{name}}" exists — saving will overwrite it.
preset.needTarget: Choose a screen, window or area before saving a preset

fx.freezeOutside: Move the playhead inside the clip
fx.freezeHint: Inserts a still segment (silent); later clips on this track move back.
fx.addKeyframeHint: Store the current position / size / rotation / opacity as a keyframe
fx.keyframeHint: Keyframes exist: move the playhead and adjust a slider to add / update a keyframe there.
fx.staticHint: No keyframes: values apply to the whole clip. Add a keyframe to animate.
fx.transitionHint: If a clip sits right before on the same track, it transitions between the two; otherwise it reveals over the layers below.

marker.title: Markers
marker.empty: No markers yet. Press M to add a marker at the playhead.
marker.label: Marker name
marker.hint: M: add a marker at the playhead. Click ▼ on the ruler to jump to it.

brand.title: Brand theme
brand.colors: Brand colors (shown in every color picker)
brand.hint: Applies to newly added text and to color pickers; existing text is unchanged.

pack.hint: Package the project and all its media into a .zip to move it to another computer

update.hint: Opens the GitHub releases page in your browser (the app itself never connects to the network).

callout.title: Callout
callout.hint: Move the box in Motion; the pointer keeps pointing at the same spot.

keys.title: Keystrokes
keys.enabled: Show keyboard shortcuts in the video
keys.hint: Uses the keystrokes captured while recording (turn on "Record keystrokes" in the recording setup).

afx.title: Advanced audio
afx.hint: Processed on your computer; nothing is uploaded. Noise reduction runs in the background for long files; the preview switches to it when ready.

track.magnetic: Magnetic track: clips snap together with no gaps
track.duck: Ducking: lowers this track while other tracks have speech (for background music)

group.hint: Ctrl+click to select more clips, then group them — grouped clips move and delete together

captions.title: Captions
captions.downloadFailed: Couldn't download the model: {{detail}}. Everything else in the app keeps working.
captions.privacy: Audio is processed on this computer and never uploaded. Only the model file is downloaded (once), when you agree.
captions.animated: Animated captions: highlight the spoken word
captions.downloadBody: The {{model}} model ({{size}}) is downloaded once from huggingface.co to transcribe on this computer. Only the model is downloaded; your audio is never sent anywhere.

batch.title: Batch export
batch.hint: Each project becomes an export job in the queue (progress at the bottom). File name = project name.
